facts.business: Sibar Autoparts Ltd manufactures auto components such as Cylinder Heads, Crankcases for Three Wheelers, Aluminium parts for CAC tanks, and Aluminium Parts in Electrical Segments such as Connectors and Core boxes.

auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Key Audit Matters: Rejections/re-works in production process; Long overdues from debtors; Persistent cash losses; Outstanding MSME Dues of ₹3,18,84,232 with non-provision of interest under MSMED Act.

key_risks: Financial risks: market risk, credit risk, liquidity risk
Foreign currency risk (USD exposure for exports)
Changes in Government Policies and Regulations
Internal Risk, Credit Risk, Liquidity Risk, Maturity of Financial Liabilities, Interest Rate Risk
